verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing and remote-control app. The evidence documents only single-item actions: closing one window via its thumbnail, removing one paired device, forgetting one Mac. A remote-access tool could plausibly offer batch actions, such as acting on several windows or devices at once, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack shows any bulk or multi-item operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
